name: OMath
description: Represents an equation. OMath objects are members of the OMaths collection.
remarks: Use the Add method of the OMaths collection to create an equation and add it to a document, selection, or range. The following example creates an equation and uses the BuildUp method to convert the equation to professional format.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMath object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained in the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Functions
properties.description: Returns an OMathFunctions collection that represents the functions contained within an equation. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathType constant that represents whether an equation is displayed inline with the text around it or displayed on its own line. Read/write.

properties.name: ParentOMath
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the parent element. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentFunction
properties.description: Returns an OMathFunction object that represents the parent, or containing, function. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentRow
properties.description: Returns an OMathMatRow object that represents the parent row in a matrix. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentCol
properties.description: Returns an OMathMatCol object that represents the parent column in a matrix. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentArg
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the parent, or containing, argument. Read-only.

properties.name: ArgIndex
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the argument index of this component relative to the containing math object. Read-only.

properties.name: NestingLevel
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the nesting level for an OMath object. Read-only.

properties.name: ArgSize
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the script size of an argument, for example, text, script, or script-script. Read/write.

properties.name: Breaks
properties.description: Returns an OMathBreaks collection that represents the line breaks in an equation. Read-only.

properties.name: Justification
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathJc that represents the justification for an equation. Read/write.

properties.name: AlignPoint
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the character position of the alignment point in the equation. Read/write.

methods.name: Linearize
methods.description: Converts an equation to linear format.

methods.name: BuildUp
methods.description: Converts an equation to professional format.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an equation from the collection of equations in a document, range, or selection.

methods.name: ConvertToMathText
methods.description: Converts an equation to math text.

methods.name: ConvertToNormalText
methods.description: Converts an equation to normal text.

methods.name: ConvertToLiteralText
methods.description: Converts an equation to literal text.
